create_qr_directive: create a docutils RST directive that generates QR codes as inline SVG in documentation
build_qr_svg: build an SVG QR code from a text string using the qrcode library with SvgPathFillImage
convert_mm_to_rem: convert a measurement in millimeters to CSS rem units at 96 DPI
register_qr_directive: register the qr directive with docutils so it can be used in reStructuredText documents
compress_qr_svg: compress generated QR code SVG by removing unnecessary whitespace and attributes
